purpose: Shared longitudinal Portfolio progress, Mastery Goal reporting, PowerSchool, and family-report behavior for courses using the canonical Portfolio runtime.
precedence: For Portfolio I Can progress, Mastery Goal grade/status, PowerSchool score, student-report progress display, and class-opportunity timing, this contract supersedes conflicting legacy course-policy clauses. Exact course learning content and I Can membership remain owned by the current Course Framework and Unit Assessment Plan.

i_can_progress.label: Not Yet Assessed
i_can_progress.rule: The class has not had an assessment opportunity for this I Can yet and no stronger student-specific evidence exists.

i_can_progress.label: Started
i_can_progress.rule: The class has had at least one assessment opportunity, but this student does not yet have enough evidence to show progress. This may include absence, a missed check, or unsuccessful evidence.

i_can_progress.label: Developing
i_can_progress.rule: Meaningful partial understanding is visible, but not yet enough for one solid demonstration.

i_can_progress.label: Progressing
i_can_progress.rule: At least one independent convincing demonstration exists, or sufficiently consistent independent partial evidence clearly shows the core understanding even when a secondary detail remains wrong. The deterministic repeated-partial default is three independent PARTIAL opportunities.

i_can_progress.label: Mastered
i_can_progress.rule: At least two independent convincing demonstrations support the target.

i_can_progress.label: Extended
i_can_progress.rule: Mastery is established and meaningful transfer/extension evidence goes beyond the target.

evidence_interpretation.principle: Evidence should accumulate according to demonstrated understanding, not only completely correct performances.
evidence_interpretation.core_vs_secondary_detail: A response may show the core concept even when a secondary representation/detail is wrong. Repeated meaningful partial understanding can advance progress without being treated as zero understanding.
evidence_interpretation.example: Repeatedly identifying x-intercept 3 while omitting the ordered-pair form (3, 0) is meaningful evidence of intercept identification; the representation detail remains a gap but the conceptual evidence still counts.

class_opportunities.i_can_rule: Count distinct non-observation class assessment sources that produced a mapped judgment for this I Can for any student. A student absence does not erase the class opportunity.
class_opportunities.mastery_goal_rule: Count distinct non-observation class assessment sources that produced a mapped judgment for any I Can in the Mastery Goal for any student.
class_opportunities.teacher_observation_rule: Direct teacher observations and walk-around observations may contribute student evidence but do not advance the class-opportunity clock used for absence/F timing.
class_opportunities.same_source_rule: Multiple prompts or multiple students from the same source do not create extra class opportunities.

mastery_goal_model.c_rule: C when at least ceil(75% of the goal's exact I Cans) are Progressing or better.
mastery_goal_model.b_rule: B when the C coverage threshold is met and at least ceil(50% of the exact I Cans) are Mastered or Extended.
mastery_goal_model.a_rule: A when every exact I Can is Mastered or Extended.
mastery_goal_model.a_plus_rule: A+ when every exact I Can is Mastered or Extended and at least one I Can is Extended.
mastery_goal_model.below_c_before_two_opportunities: Do not report I. If the class has had no assessment opportunity for the goal, report Not Yet Assessed. After one class opportunity, use a blank/dash grade box while evidence is still building.
mastery_goal_model.falling_behind_rule: After at least two class assessment opportunities, a goal below C reports Falling Behind when meaningful growth is visible. Falling Behind is an intervention/support signal, not automatically an F.
mastery_goal_model.f_rule: After at least two class assessment opportunities, use F only when the student has no meaningful growth in the goal: no I Can has reached Developing or better. This includes repeated missing/no-usable-evidence situations.
mastery_goal_model.meaningful_growth: At least one exact I Can in the goal is Developing or better.

powerschool.unit_grade: No overall Unit letter grade is exported.

student_report.design_rule: Preserve the approved recurring report. This is a minimal-change update, not a redesign.
student_report.summary_right_panel: Replace Mastery Goal snapshot with a compact text-only Status guide using the six exact progress definitions. Do not put progress bars in the guide.
student_report.i_can_rows: Replace the legacy circle/star and visible Next line with a five-segment progress bar followed by the short progress label.
student_report.mg_cards: Each Mastery Goal card shows one equal-size status/grade box at the upper right. The exact number of I Cans comes from current learning authority; never assume four universally. Do not duplicate the MG status at the bottom.
student_report.recent_evidence: Show the four most recent assessed evidence events in true ledger order. Repeated evidence for the same I Can may appear when it is among the four most recent events. If fewer than four assessed events exist, show all available events.
student_report.page_2: Keep the existing Recent Evidence & Next Steps, Your Practice, Strengths, I Cans to improve, Practice Builder link, Current focus, and footer structure.

student_actions.visibility: Next-action codes remain internal for intervention/practice routing and are not printed as a separate Next line in each student I Can row.

intervention.priority_signal: Use Falling Behind/F Mastery Goals plus actionable PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Cans instead of a visible/current I grade.
intervention.falling_behind_not_failure: Students may be Falling Behind while still showing meaningful growth and therefore have a blank PowerSchool score.
